title: Evaluating an AI Writing Tool for Work
paragraphs: Assigned to evaluate whether her department should adopt a new artificial intelligence writing assistant, Melati approached the tool with considerable skepticism, having heard mixed reports about accuracy and overreliance from colleagues at other companies.

During her testing period, she discovered the tool genuinely accelerated routine drafting tasks but frequently produced factual errors in specialized content that required careful, informed review before anything could be published.

Rather than recommending either wholesale adoption or complete rejection, Melati proposed a measured policy: using the tool specifically for initial drafts of routine communications while requiring thorough human review for anything factually sensitive.

A year after implementing her nuanced recommendation, the department reported meaningful time savings without the accuracy problems that had concerned her initially, validating her instinct that thoughtful, limited adoption often served better than an all-or-nothing decision.
